baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive construction كل نفس and the accompaniment phrase معها سائق وشهيد bind two roles to each arriving self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Every self arrives as a whole accountable unit: the driver effects its movement, while the witness supplies observed presence and knowledgeable declaration.

activation_trace.role: Coming and occurrence supply the arrival event.
Complete inclusion makes the event distributive over every self.
The thing itself and its identity make the arriving unit the whole person.
Driving, herding, and impelling supply directed movement.
Presence with direct observation supplies an attending witness.
Knowledgeable declaration gives the attending witness an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: A self merely appears with two companions.
changed_reading.after: Each whole self is delivered as an attestable case: one role directs movement and the other makes its presence and account manifest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb جاءت stands beside the active role سائق under the universal كل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The form-distant causative branch of coming, reinforced by explicit driving, permits an exploratory reading in which arrival is imposed rather than self-initiated.

activation_trace.role: Causing someone to come by compulsion supplies a form-distant forced-arrival possibility.
Driving and impelling give the forced-arrival possibility a focus-visible mechanism.
Complete inclusion extends that imposed transfer to every self.

changed_reading.before: Every self comes under its own motion.
changed_reading.after: Every self may be made to arrive, with the driver embodying the loss of control over that transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: A preserved record, knowledge of inward whispering, continuous speech monitoring, and a prepared companion who speaks turn the generic witness into an account-bearing attendant; testimony manifests an already preserved case rather than supplying missing knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Mind and inward intent keep the account tied to the self's interior.
Knowledgeable declaration supplies the focus witness's evidentiary role.
An inscription that establishes judgment supplies the durable case record.
Guarding and preservation keep that record intact.
Hidden self-talk extends the evidentiary field into inward speech.
Speech emitted by the tongue supplies observable material for the account.
Watching and waiting supply continuous observation.
Being present and prepared makes the observer ready for later presentation.
A companion joined to its associate sharpens the focus accompaniment into durable pairing.
Spoken utterance turns the prepared companion into a presenting voice.

structural_cues: The preserved book at 50:4 precedes the monitoring sequence at 50:16-18.
عتيد recurs at 50:18 and 50:23, where a companion speaks immediately after the focus arrival.
The focus معها and 50:23 قرينه both mark close accompaniment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation, inner and outer speech, monitoring, preparedness, and companion speech; I infer continuity from recording to courtroom presentation. A live alternative is that the watcher, witness, and speaking companion are separate attendants rather than one role.

changed_reading.before: The witness is simply an eyewitness standing beside the self.
changed_reading.after: The witness is plausibly a prepared, record-bearing companion who presents the self's already preserved inward and outward account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated جاءت, the death stupor one cannot turn aside from, and the intervening horn signal make the focus arrival the enforced second stage of a death-to-assembly transfer; the later negation of human compulsion bounds that force to event custody rather than coerced belief during proclamation.

activation_trace.role: The immediately preceding coming event begins the transition sequence.
Loss of wakeful control marks the transition's overpowering threshold.
Departure of life supplies the threshold from which the self is transferred.
Turning aside from a path supplies attempted evasion that the sequence closes.
Sending air into something supplies the activating signal between death and arrival.
The horn of blowing identifies that signal's instrument.
Driving and impelling operationalize the unavoidable transfer at the focus.
Domination by coercion, here negated of the addressee, limits rather than erases the later driver's force.

structural_cues: 50:19 and 50:21 both begin with جاءت, with the horn verse between them.
The avoided death threshold precedes the driver; the negated جبار occurs only in the closing proclamation scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated coming, failed evasion, a horn signal, and a later negated human compeller; I infer a causal sequence and a temporal boundary between warning and compulsory transfer. Alternatively, جبار may constrain only the addressee without defining the focus driver.

changed_reading.before: The driver is a generic coercive companion attached to arrival.
changed_reading.after: The driver enforces the irreversible post-death transfer into assembly, without implying that the earlier proclamation coerces belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The universal escorted arrival precedes two differently directed movements: casting a specified class and bringing the garden near to another class. The later parallel of coming with one's core condition makes the focus pair part of intake and disclosure, not an automatic mark of condemnation.

activation_trace.role: Directed driving brings every case to the common intake point.
A sign that indicates condition makes the witness relevant before destination is assigned.
Throwing until something is cast supplies the later punitive movement.
Complete inclusion ranges here over every member of a specified punitive class.
Movement into nearness supplies a contrasting, non-punitive destination movement.
Complete inclusion also ranges over every member of the returning, preserving class.
A later coming event parallels the focus arrival on the favorable branch.
The core or essence carried in that arrival supplies disclosed inward condition.

structural_cues: The universal 50:21 precedes the punitive sequence at 50:24-30 and the garden sequence at 50:31-35.
كل recurs within both specified classes, while جاء recurs with a returning heart at 50:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal arrival followed by opposed destination movements and a favorable coming-with-core parallel; I infer that 50:21 is common intake before sorting. A live alternative is that the dual casting command at 50:24 addresses the focus pair and ties their next action specifically to the punitive branch.

changed_reading.before: Having a driver and witness already identifies every arriving self as condemned.
changed_reading.after: Driver and witness belong to a universal evidentiary intake; condemnation or welcome is differentiated only in the movements that follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing image of earth opening, rapid emergence, and a gathering explicitly defined as driving a group to a destination turns the focus into the case-level organization of a mass muster: collective transport is decomposed into one escorted, marked self at a time.

activation_trace.role: Complete distributive inclusion decomposes the collective event across individuals.
Each thing in its own identity supplies the gathering's case-level unit.
Following in one track supplies ordered processional movement.
An indicating mark keeps each moving case identifiable within the mass.
Splitting and opening supply the release of the assembled population from earth.
The opposite of slowness supplies rapid movement into the muster.
Driving a group and gathering it to a destination supplies the collective logistics behind سائق.
Light, compliant movement explains the gathering's declared ease.

structural_cues: The singular-distributive كل نفس in the focus contrasts with the collective حشر at 50:44.
The late gathering summary supplies the destination-scale frame for the earlier driver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening earth, speed, easy gathering, and a branch image of driving a group to a destination; I infer that the focus individualizes that collective operation into accountable files. Alternatively, 50:44 may recap only resurrection and not specify the focus companions' logistics.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts an isolated person's entrance.
changed_reading.after: It depicts the individualized lane of a rapid mass muster, where each self remains separately escorted and evidentially identifiable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because معها شهيد most readily presents a companion distinct from the self. It remains anchored by the focus self/presence branches, the unveiled sharp sight at 50:22, and the exact reuse of شهيد for an attentive hearer at 50:37. Render only as a possible reflexive layer in which the unveiled self participates in witnessing; do not replace or identify away the external witness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins نفس, accompaniment, and شهيد; the presence branch can describe a state of conscious attendance as well as an evidentiary attendant.

activation_trace.role: The self in its own identity supplies the possible reflexive subject.
Presence with direct observation permits a state of witnessing as well as a separate witness.
Lifting a covering supplies the change that enables direct awareness.
A concealing cover supplies the prior block on that awareness.
Visual perception supplies the self's newly active witnessing faculty.
A sharp, penetrating edge supplies intensified perception.
The heart supplies an inward faculty for attentive presence.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies active receptivity.
The repeated presence branch applies شهيد to the attentive hearer and activates the reflexive layer.

changed_reading.before: Only an external witness sees and attests the arriving self.
changed_reading.after: Once its cover is removed, the arriving self may also become consciously present to its own exposed case, alongside the still-live external witness.

strongest_changes: The witness became a prepared, preserved-account-bearing companion rather than a generic observer.
The driver became the custodian of an unavoidable death-to-assembly transfer, while coercion during proclamation remained excluded.
The universal arrival became a pre-sorting, individualized intake within a rapid mass gathering and therefore did not itself imply condemnation.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated coming, record and readiness vocabulary, divergent destination movements, and the late gathering root jointly activated a custody-plus-evidence mechanism; the repeated شهيد after unveiled perception left a contained reflexive layer.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether driver, witness, watcher, and speaking companion are distinct entities or overlapping functions remains unresolved.
The dual casting command at 50:24 may address the focus pair, but the packet does not settle that identification.
The forced-coming branch is causative and form-distant, so it should not bear the compulsory-transfer reading without the explicit driver and context sequence.
